caption: The drawing shows an ornate panel design set within a rectangular border, featuring a central vertical composition on a blue background. In the center, three stylized urns or vases are arranged vertically with elaborate scrollwork and floral patterns extending outward from each urn. The urns and scrollwork are rendered in light ochre or gold tones with pinkish highlights, while additional floral motifs, symmetrical leaves, and bell-shaped flowers hang from the scrolls. The blue panel is bordered by decorative bands in pale beige and pink, with fine ornamentation. Surrounding the central blue rectangle are larger geometric fields in a muted pink, each outlined with thin cream-colored and patterned edges. The overall composition is framed by a thick beige mat with a fine double border in black.
title: Plaster Ornament
